nodes.description: State variable holding the ZethrInterface proxy target at a hardcoded address; used for balanceOf and buyAndTransfer calls.
State variable address that receives contract balance in sendDivsToBankroll and can be changed by the owner.
State variable initialized to msg.sender at deployment; used as the access-control authority for changeBankroll and sendDivsToBankroll.
Untrusted caller address used for balance queries, token purchase target, and owner comparisons.
Public payable function that reads balance before and after an external buyAndTransfer call and emits onTokenPurchase with the minted amount.
Payable fallback function that accepts ether without any logic or event.
Public function guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) that updates the bankroll address.
Public function guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) that transfers the entire contract balance to bankroll.
Parameter of buyTokensWithProperEvent forwarded as referral address to the external buyAndTransfer call.
Parameter of buyTokensWithProperEvent forwarded as the dividend rate selector to buyAndTransfer.
Parameter of changeBankroll written into the bankroll state variable.
Local variable caching zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) before the external purchase.
Local variable caching zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) after the external purchase; trusted as ground truth for tokens minted.
External payable call zethr.buyAndTransfer.value(msg.value)(_referredBy, msg.sender, "", divChoice) to an attacker-influenceable interface address, executed before the post-state is measured.
External ether transfer bankroll.transfer(address(this).balance) that forwards the entire balance to a state-controlled address.
Unchecked subtraction used to compute tokensMinted; can underflow and is derived from an externally controllable balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside buyTokensWithProperEvent for balanceOf lookups and as the purchase target.
buyTokensWithProperEvent performs the external payable buyAndTransfer call before finalizing the reported minted amount.
The external buyAndTransfer call to a state-controlled interface address can re-enter buyTokensWithProperEvent (or the fallback) before balances/events are settled.
Parameter _referredBy is consumed by buyTokensWithProperEvent.
_referredBy is forwarded as the referral argument into the external buyAndTransfer call.
Parameter divChoice is consumed by buyTokensWithProperEvent.
divChoice is forwarded as the dividend rate selector into the external buyAndTransfer call.
msg.sender is passed as the target argument of the external buyAndTransfer call.
buyTokensWithProperEvent assigns balanceBefore from zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender).
buyTokensWithProperEvent assigns balanceAfter after the external call.
balanceBefore is an operand of the subtraction balanceAfter - balanceBefore, whose result is unchecked.
balanceAfter is an operand of the unchecked subtraction producing tokensMinted.
The subtraction result is emitted by buyTokensWithProperEvent as the tokensMinted event argument.
changeBankroll authorizes the untrusted msg.sender via require(msg.sender == owner).
The owner state variable is the authorization reference checked by changeBankroll.
_newBankroll is the input parameter written by changeBankroll.
_newBankroll is written into the bankroll state variable.
changeBankroll mutates the bankroll state variable.
sendDivsToBankroll authorizes the untrusted msg.sender via require(msg.sender == owner) before moving funds.
The owner state variable is the authorization reference checked by sendDivsToBankroll.
sendDivsToBankroll executes an external value transfer to bankroll.
The bankroll.transfer external call hands control to a state-controlled address that can re-enter sendDivsToBankroll or the payable fallback.
The bankroll state variable is the recipient of the external ether transfer.
The zethr state variable supplies the external contract invoked for buyAndTransfer.
The zethr state variable is queried via balanceOf inside buyTokensWithProperEvent.
The payable fallback accepts ether sent by any untrusted msg.sender without checks.

normalization_plan.reason: The _referredBy parameter has no independent semantics; it is only forwarded as an argument of the external buyAndTransfer call.
divChoice is only used as the dividend rate selector argument of the external buyAndTransfer call.
_newBankroll exists solely to be assigned into the bankroll state variable inside changeBankroll.
balanceBefore is a temporary cache whose only use is as the left operand of the subtraction producing tokensMinted.
balanceAfter is a temporary cache whose only use is as the right operand of the subtraction producing tokensMinted.
